svg.aria-label: On the Enable Banking portal. Sign in: type your email, Continue, then open the link you receive. Create the application, Add a new application: Environment Production, Private key Generate in the browser, Application name SmartBudget, then paste the values copied from SmartBudget: Allowed redirect URLs https://cybertrist.github.io/SmartBudget/, the description, Privacy URL and Terms URL; Email for data protection, your email. Register: a .pem file downloads, this is the key, never rename it. Then Activate by linking accounts: country, your bank, type personal, Link, and you confirm at your bank. The application is active, in free restricted mode.

svg.text: Free, for your own accounts. SmartBudget tells you what to type and what to paste.

g.text: Enter your email, we’ll send you a sign-in link.
Open the link you receive: the account creates itself the first time.
Application personnelle de suivi de budget…
downloaded: this is your key, keep its name
→ your bank opens: you confirm as usual
Application active, in free restricted mode.
Back in SmartBudget: Import the key.

svg.text: the link you receive, opened in the browser
Production, key generated in the browser
your bank, type personal, then Link
its name is your application’s ID.
